set.body:
Acceptance criteria:
- Support matrix has no silent gaps.
- Clean tarball passes local gate with zero errors/warnings and reviewed notes/skips.
- Linux/macOS/Windows/sanitizer/docs/performance workflows pass on release commit.
- Installed smokes cover every supported flagship family.
- README/site state honest scope and limitations.
- Version, NEWS, citation, artifact SHA-256, commit, and hosted evidence are recorded.
set.title: Certify the focused rfugw 0.1 release candidate
